current_evidence: No local validation list was found. The planning landing page, the 'Planning applications and decisions' page (last updated 11 June 2024) and the 'Planning Pre-Application' page (last updated 1 April 2026) do not mention or link one. Two searches (one limited to wolverhampton.gov.uk) found none, and planning.data.gov.uk entity 20311 records 'Couldn't find any sort of checklist' with only the planning landing page as documentation.

issues.detail: The 'Validation list URL' is the generic Planning landing page, not a validation list. The page loads, but it contains no validation list, local list or checklist and links to none.
issues.evidence: wolverhampton.gov.uk/planning: 'Information on City of Wolverhampton Councils planning services'; links only to pre-application, applications and decisions, and 'Do I need planning permission?'

issues.detail: The Status 'Link only (not readable: blocked/404/login)' is inaccurate. The URL is readable; the real finding is that the council does not appear to publish a local validation list online. The URL is also labelled as coming from a third-party directory (planninggeek.co.uk) and was not verified.
issues.evidence: WebFetch of https://www.wolverhampton.gov.uk/planning returned the page normally

issues.detail: 'Planning page' is set to the council homepage (https://www.wolverhampton.gov.uk) rather than the planning section (https://www.wolverhampton.gov.uk/planning) or the 'Planning applications and decisions' page.

summary: Grokbot's link is just Wolverhampton's generic planning page, wrongly marked as unreadable. No published local validation list could be found on the council site or in national data, so no contents could be checked; the 'not covered' rows are correct to leave requirements empty.
